Real-data dry run result, 2026-11-17 18:23–19:05 PST (ESCALATION for the pre-swap human go/no-go; not ticked, not closed).
Setup: fresh TMPDIR workdir with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set; T0 = origin/tickets 23331185617 fetched by commit into an empty repo (no remote); published only to a file:// fake remote inside the workdir. source_ref_unchanged=true. The run drove the merged harness functions (0433dec3663, which includes the ledger-anchor fix b45a4b7f8ef and the stdout mark fix 0445db3b624) from a small driver script, with one deviation: identity was compared with ADVISORY verify-identity, because an enforced whole-store verify-identity --all on the same kind of copy ran 5.5 h without finishing (killed; per-event era/ancestry git checks — see tame-melodious-veery and coal-trainsick-heifer). CI runs advisory today (rebar.toml require_authenticated=false).
Results (evidence.json):
- blobless pack: 641,727 KiB (626.7 MiB) before -> 109,046 KiB (106.5 MiB) after; delta 532,681 KiB. Prediction was 365-380 MiB; actual is far below it (within_prediction=false in the favourable direction). The CI guard's restored target is 102,400 KiB; after-size is 6,646 KiB above that.
- commits: 309,878 before -> 13,196 after (296,685 collapsed, 13,193 replayed); boundary c4ac5e93f91; checkpoint 7f6762d0cae; new tip 75af3bbbd57; backup ref refs/tickets-backup/pre-reclaim-20261118T025254Z on the fake remote.
- reducer_equal=true over 10,296 tickets (ledger commit_sha excluded by design; 69,857 ledger entries rewritten).
- identity (advisory): 49,544 signed / 874 unsigned / 50,418 in scope, identical before and after.
- enforce_since 65f510ec357 is an ancestor of the new tip (enforce_since_on_branch=true).
- step seconds: copy 117, fake remote 83, shadow 147, reduce 60/58, pack 177/11, identity 51/38, collapse 1,126, publish 33.
Not established: an ENFORCED era check on the rewritten history (blocked on tame-melodious-veery); S3-backend swap (covered only by fake-S3 tests). No production swap was executed.
